tagline: Desmos graphs as code, with classes
brief: A preprocessor for DesModder's Text Mode: you write text, Desmos draws the graph. The mark should say TMC first, feel calculated rather than hand-drawn, and work as a 16 px browser-toolbar icon.
criteria: Shows TMC, reads as a graph without explanation, holds up at 16 px, keeps the navy from the old icon.

concepts.name: Tmc++
concepts.idea: The m of TMC is two periods of a cosine on a Desmos grid, ending in a draggable point.
rationale: Text that is also a graph: the whole product in one letter
Exact construction: the grid pitch is half a period, so peaks, troughs and the axes all line up
A small-size cut keeps Tmc legible in the 16 px Chrome toolbar

recommendation: Use the tile icon wherever a square is needed, the wordmark in headers and READMEs.
next_steps: Swap the extension and VS Code icons
Refresh the Chrome Web Store promo tile
Use the wordmark in the README header
